snippet.title: Lizard State - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4435590/Lizard_State/

Lizard State is a stealth action game inspired by the classics. Sneak through the shadows and use your environment to make your way deep within enemy lines, on an island overtaken by a renegade group.
